about.text: Rasabali is a sweet of Odisha: flat palm-sized patties of chhena deep-fried until reddish-brown and soaked in rabri, thickened sweetened milk with cardamom. It began as an offering at the Baladevjew temple in Kendrapara and received a GI tag in October 2023.
